courseDescription: Interactive cases for ethical inquiry and discussion.

activities.title: The Nurse Who Thought the Code Was Wrong: Part 1
activities.description: A nurse objects, on religious grounds, to stopping a resident's tube feedings. Read the consultation request, interview the people involved, and record a provisional recommendation.

activities.title: The Nurse Who Thought the Code Was Wrong: Part 2
activities.description: Opens with a separate code after Part 1. Examine new evidence, analyze the case, make a final recommendation, and download your consultation report.

activities.title: Demonstration Activity (not a course case)
activities.description: A short demonstration used to test the code prompt, a written response, and a report download. It contains no course content.
